title: Prepositions of time (including in/on/at) - Time expressions mastery

options.answer: I have a meeting on 2:30 PM.
I have a meeting at 2:30 PM.
I have a meeting in 2:30 PM.

explanation.en: Use 'at' for specific times like 'at 2:30 PM' or 'at midnight'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'at' для указания точного времени, например 'at 2:30 PM' или 'at midnight'.
explanation.uz: Aniq vaqtni ko'rsatish uchun 'at' ishlatiladi, masalan, 'at 2:30 PM' yoki 'at midnight'.

options.answer: We go on holiday at the summer.
We go on holiday on the summer.
We go on holiday in the summer.

explanation.en: Use 'in' for seasons like 'in the summer' and 'in the winter'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'in' с названиями времен года, например 'in the summer' и 'in the winter'.
explanation.uz: Mavsum nomlari bilan 'in' ishlatiladi, masalan, 'in the summer' va 'in the winter'.

explanation.en: Use 'on' for specific dates, like 'on October 10th'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'on' для конкретных дат, например 'on October 10th'.
explanation.uz: Aniq sanalar uchun 'on' ishlatiladi, masalan, 'on October 10th'.

explanation.en: Use 'on' for days of the week, like 'on Saturday' or 'on Monday'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'on' с днями недели, например 'on Saturday' или 'on Monday'.
explanation.uz: Hafta kunlari bilan 'on' ishlatiladi, masalan, 'on Saturday' yoki 'on Monday'.

options.answer: I will see you on the morning.
I will see you in the morning.
I will see you at the morning.

explanation.en: Use 'in' for parts of the day, except for 'at night'. So it's 'in the morning', 'in the afternoon', and 'in the evening'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'in' с частями дня, за исключением 'at night'. Например, 'in the morning', 'in the afternoon' и 'in the evening'.
explanation.uz: Kun qismlari bilan 'at night'dan tashqari 'in' ishlatiladi. Masalan, 'in the morning', 'in the afternoon' va 'in the evening'.

explanation.en: Use 'in' for months, like 'in November' or 'in March'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'in' с названиями месяцев, например 'in November' или 'in March'.
explanation.uz: Oylar nomlari bilan 'in' ishlatiladi, masalan, 'in November' yoki 'in March'.

options.answer: We went to the beach at the weekend.
We went to the beach on the weekend.
We went to the beach in the weekend.

explanation.en: For 'weekend,' you can use either 'on' or 'at' ('on the weekend' is more common in American English, 'at the weekend' in British English). Both are acceptable, but 'on the weekend' is a common A2 usage.
explanation.ru: С 'weekend' можно использовать как 'on', так и 'at' ('on the weekend' чаще используется в американском английском, 'at the weekend' — в британском). Оба варианта приемлемы, но 'on the weekend' — более распространенное употребление на уровне A2.
explanation.uz: 'Weekend' so'zi bilan 'on' yoki 'at' ishlatish mumkin ('on the weekend' Amerika inglizchasida, 'at the weekend' Britaniya inglizchasida ko'proq uchraydi). Ikkalasi ham qabul qilinadi, lekin 'on the weekend' A2 darajasida ko'proq tarqalgan.

explanation.en: Use 'in' for years and centuries, like 'in 2020' or 'in the 21st century'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'in' с годами и веками, например 'in 2020' или 'in the 21st century'.
explanation.uz: Yillar va asrlar bilan 'in' ishlatiladi, masalan, 'in 2020' yoki 'in the 21st century'.

options.answer: The sun rises at the morning.
The sun rises on the morning.
The sun rises in the morning.

explanation.en: Use 'in' for parts of the day, such as 'in the morning,' 'in the afternoon,' and 'in the evening.'
explanation.ru: Используйте 'in' с частями дня, такими как 'in the morning', 'in the afternoon' и 'in the evening'.
explanation.uz: Kun qismlari bilan 'in' ishlatiladi, masalan, 'in the morning', 'in the afternoon' va 'in the evening'.

options.answer: The party is at next Friday.
The party is on next Friday.

explanation.en: Do not use a preposition before time expressions with 'next', 'last', 'this', and 'every'.
explanation.ru: Не используйте предлоги перед выражениями времени, содержащими 'next', 'last', 'this' и 'every'.
explanation.uz: 'next', 'last', 'this' va 'every' bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt iboralari oldidan predlog ishlatmang.

items.text: My friend, Sarah, is a very busy person. She always wakes up early ___1___ the morning, usually ___2___ 6 a.m. ___3___ Tuesdays and Thursdays, she has a yoga class. She goes to work ___4___ 8:30 a.m. every day. ___5___ the afternoon, she has lunch with her colleagues. Her work finishes ___6___ 5 p.m., but sometimes she works late ___7___ night. ___8___ the weekend, she likes to relax. ___9___ winter, she goes skiing, and ___10___ summer, she likes to swim. Last year, she went to Spain ___11___ July. She has a big family reunion ___12___ August 15th every year. Her grandparents were born ___13___ the 1950s. She always calls her grandmother ___14___ her birthday. The grandmother's birthday is ___15___ December 20th.

explanation.en: This exercise tests the use of 'in' for months, years, and seasons; 'at' for specific times and 'night'; and 'on' for days and specific dates.
explanation.ru: Это упражнение проверяет использование 'in' с месяцами, годами и временами года; 'at' для точного времени и 'night'; и 'on' для дней и конкретных дат.
explanation.uz: Ushbu mashq 'in' predlogining oylar, yillar va fasllar bilan; 'at' predlogining aniq vaqt va 'night' bilan; 'on' predlogining esa kunlar va aniq sanalar bilan ishlatilishini tekshiradi.
